title: Discrete Model-Based Diffusion for Combinatorial Optimization in Multi-Robot Task Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision making in multi-agent and multi-robot systems often involves discrete decision variables, leading to NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems that must be solved within seconds for near real-time implementation. Denoising diffusion has emerged as a powerful tool for such problems, but existing approaches face a trade-off: Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) incorporates diffusion in sampling-based optimization (SBO) without training but only over continuous spaces, while existing diffusion-based combinatorial solvers operate over discrete spaces but require offline training. To this end, we propose Discrete Model-Based Diffusion (Discrete MBD), a training-free SBO method that directly optimizes discrete variables by approximating categorical reverse transition distributions through Monte Carlo sampling. We establish a finite-step lower bound on the probability of finding a global minimizer and show that this bound converges to one

translated_title: 面向多机器人任务分配中组合优化的离散基于模型扩散
translated_abstract: 多智能体与多机器人系统中的决策通常涉及离散决策变量，由此产生必须在数秒内求解以满足近实时应用的NP难组合优化问题。去噪扩散已成为解决此类问题的强大工具，但现有方法面临权衡：基于模型的扩散无需训练即可将扩散融入基于采样的优化中，但仅在连续空间上有效；而现有的基于扩散的组合优化求解器虽然工作在离散空间上，却需要离线训练。为此，我们提出离散基于模型扩散，这是一种无需训练的基于采样的优化方法，通过蒙特卡洛采样近似类别型反向转移分布，从而直接优化离散变量。我们建立了找到全局最小值概率的有限步下界，并证明该下界收敛于一（摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的离散基于模型扩散方法，通过蒙特卡洛采样近似类别型反向转移分布，直接在离散空间进行基于采样的优化，从而求解多机器人任务分配中的NP难组合优化问题，并给出了找到全局最优解概率的有限步下界理论保证。
en_tdlr: Discrete Model-Based Diffusion is proposed as a training-free sampling-based optimization method that directly optimizes discrete variables via Monte Carlo approximation of categorical reverse transitions, solving NP-hard combinatorial problems in multi-robot task allocation with a finite-step lower-bound guarantee on finding the global minimizer.
